newsitem.title: USA: Union Pacific seen upping Pennzoil bid-arbs.
newsitem.headline: Union Pacific seen upping Pennzoil bid-arbs.

text.p: Union Pacific Resources Group Inc is expected by arbitrageurs and traders to raise its $84 per share bid for Pennzoil, sweetening the already pricey offer, announced early Monday.

"It (Union Pacific's bid) is unsolicited and it could go a lot higher. That is what the market is saying right now. Everybody thinks it is going higher," said an arbitrageur who declined to be indentified.
Union Pacific Resources Group Inc said it is offering $84 per share for Pennzoil Co, news that sent the shares up to 85 early Monday from 59-5/8 at Friday's close.
